name: mnema-brain
displayName: Mnema — Shared Brain for You and Your AI Agents
description: Self-hostable shared brain for you and your AI agents — docs, flows, meetings, decisions, rationale

mnema_origin.title: Mnema API origin
mnema_origin.description: Your Mnema API origin. Leave the default for the hosted service, or point it at your own self-hosted instance.

capture_token.title: Capture token (optional)
capture_token.description: Token for the session-capture hook, from Settings → Developer in Mnema. Leave blank to use Mnema without capture — every tool still works.

workspace_id.title: Workspace id (optional)
workspace_id.description: Only needed alongside a capture token.
